label: chain bracelet
construction: A chain bracelet: a length of uniform links of the specified style (cable, curb, paperclip, box) closed by a clasp; any charm or plate joined to a link by a ring; no gap in the chain.
photo: Studio product photograph, soft even lighting, white seamless background, subtle shadow, the piece fills the frame, no text, no people, no props.
views: view of the whole bracelet laid in a loose oval showing the clasp
close three-quarter view of the links and any charm or plate

checks.question: Is the chain made of uniform links of the specified style with no gap?
Is there a clasp closing the bracelet?
If a charm or plate is present, is it joined to the chain by a ring or links?
